description.value: Your body has been fitted with an extradimensional space @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] underneath a subtle seam in your skin, allowing you to carry weapons or contraband into areas where they might otherwise be restricted. The extradimensional cavity functions as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Null Space Chamber (Commercial)]{commercial null space chamber}, except that it holds a maximum of 20 Bulk. The opening to the cavity is very discreet, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal it or the items within.
